name: browser
summary: A shared, visible browser for a session: the agent drives it through structured commands, the operator watches it and can take control. The session never holds site credentials.

ops.name: lease
ops.summary: Start a browser (ephemeral, or a persistent profile by name); release it with DELETE.

ops.name: command
ops.summary: One structured command: goto, snapshot, screenshot, click, fill, type, press, wait, url, title, text, download. No caller-supplied script.

ops.name: secure_login
ops.summary: Sign in with a stored credential the caller never sees (also needs repl_login).

notes: Served by the dashboard plugin `browser`. Runbook: graph://12bf59f5-813.
